Nudge

Everyday controls with one considered idea about motion each. Copy one, paste it into your page, and it works.

Copy, paste, done.

Each component is one block of HTML, CSS and a few lines of JavaScript. No install, no framework, no dependencies.

Make it yours.

Set these once and every component follows.

:root {
  --nd-accent: #2f54eb;

Moves on purpose.

Feedback on press. Motion follows direction. State changes first, animation second. A refusal is a shake. With reduced motion on, the state still changes and the travel is switched off.

Toast stack

  


    
  
    
    
    A deck you can read. New toasts land on top of the stack. Hover or focus fans them out and pauses every timer. Each toast shows its time running out, and you can swipe one away.
